title: Flute of the Outer Gods
wikitext:
[[Image:FluteOfTheOuterGods.png|right|160px]]
'''Flute of the Outer Gods''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Any Phase''': Lose 3 [[Sanity]] and 3 [[Stamina]] and discard Flute of the Outer Gods before making a [[Combat check]] to defeat all [[monster]]s in your current area.  This does not affect [[Ancient One]]s.

'''Price''': $8

[[Category:Unique items]]


== Clarification ==
You must pass a Horror Check before using the Flute.  If there are more than one monster in your area, you only need to pass one Horror Check.
